newsitem.title: USA: Instron enters venture with Carl Schenck.
newsitem.headline: Instron enters venture with Carl Schenck.

text.p: Instron Corp said on Monday it has formed a joint venture with Carl Schenck AG of Darmstadt, Germany in the structures testing market and the acquisition by Instron of Schenck's materials testing business.
Carl Schenck AG concentrates its business activities in measuring, controlling and regulating forces in the automotive, machine tool and raw material processing industries.
Both companies contributed their structures testing businesses to the venture, with Instron controlling 51 percent and Schenck holding 49 percent of Instron Schenck Testing Systems, Instron said.
The acquisition of Schenck's materials testing business comprises an asset sale to Instron of Schenck's current product lines, installed base and related assets, Instron said.
Based on the company's backlog and expected future bookings, it is estimated that Instron Schenck Testing's 1997 annual sales will exceed $50 million."
